title: SKE Crystal CL6000 Pink Lemonade Prefilled Pod - 20mg
description: The SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Pack in Pink Lemonade delivers a delightful combination of sweet citrus lemonade with subtle berry notes for a refreshing, flavourful vape. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml e-liquid refill container, providing extended use with the SKE Crystal CL6000 Prefilled Pod Kit. The pods utilise dual mesh coil technology for consistently smooth vapour and exceptional flavour intensity. The automatic refill system and leak-resistant design make refilling quick, easy, and mess-free. Together, the pod and refill container provide up to 6000 puffs, offering a long-lasting and satisfying vaping experience. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, these pods deliver a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine relief, making them an excellent choice for adult vapers seeking convenience and great performance. Replace the pod and refill container when empty to continue enjoying the refreshing Pink Lemonade flavour.
